name: StickS3 Axes & Echo
description:
A tiny dictaphone and motion viewer for StickS3. Hold KEY2 to record from the built-in mic (up to several seconds in PSRAM), release to play back through the speaker — with live spectrum, RMS/PEAK/CLIP meters, and safe ES8311 mic↔speaker switching. Between recordings, the portrait UI shows IMU accelerometer axes X/Y/Z and the acceleration vector. KEY1 cycles the background color; hold KEY1 to replay the last clip.

Screenshots (repo):
- images/recording.png — RECORD status
- images/play.png — PLAY status
- images/normal.png — IMU axes (black background)
keywords: StickS3, dictaphone, recorder, microphone, speaker, IMU, accelerometer, axes, spectrum
